assertions.name: lagrange_projector_idempotent
assertions.source: max ‖P²−P‖ over the demo blocks — the full-matrix spectral projector built from β's actual spectrum is idempotent.

description: Generic full-matrix block-swap spectral-projector infra (any block size m, any n). β (block-transposition braid) is built as a full seminormal matrix per λ⊢n; its spectrum carries far more than the Hecke {q,−q⁻¹} pair (a braid, β²=full twist≠id, on a reducible module). The Lagrange spectral projector Π_{μ≠λ}(β−μ)/(λ−μ) is verified idempotent (‖P²−P‖<1e-6). The q→1 swap multiplicities (dim S²/Λ²) anchor which q-eigenvalues are bosonic vs fermionic. Demos: (m=2,n=4) and (m=3,n=6, the 22-eigenvalue ⁴He proton-pair). Generalizes q_block_rmatrix_spectrum.py; Lean backing for the generator-level rank case in QOU.Hecke.SpectralProjector.
